panels.title: Usage · last 5 h
panels.description: Cost (cost_usd) per Claude account over the last 5 hours. Bar = that cost as % of the account's peak: its highest rolling 5-hour cost over the last 30 days (10-minute steps). Green below 60 %, yellow from 60 %, red from 80 %. Fixed windows: ignores the dashboard time range and the variables. Accounts with no cost in 7 days are not listed.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    concat(if(t.label = '', '(no account)', t.label), '  ·  $', toString(round(t.h5, 2))) AS name,
    round(100 * t.h5 / greatest(p.peak, t.h5, 0.000001)) AS pct
FROM
(
    SELECT account_uuid,
           argMax(account, ts) AS label,
           sumIf(cost_usd, ts >= now() - INTERVAL 5 HOUR) AS h5,
           sumIf(cost_usd, ts >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS d7
    FROM cc.api_requests
    WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
    GROUP BY account_uuid
) AS t
LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT account_uuid, max(w) AS peak
    FROM
    (
        SELECT account_uuid,
               sum(c) OVER (PARTITION BY account_uuid ORDER BY b RANGE BETWEEN 17999 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS w
        FROM
        (
            SELECT account_uuid, toUInt32(toStartOfInterval(ts, INTERVAL 10 MINUTE)) AS b, sum(cost_usd) AS c
            FROM cc.api_requests
            WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
            GROUP BY account_uuid, b
        )
    )
    GROUP BY account_uuid
) AS p ON p.account_uuid = t.account_uuid
WHERE t.d7 > 0
ORDER BY t.h5 DESC, t.d7 DESC

panels.title: Tips · 7 d
panels.description: Number of tips (view cc.tips, last 7 days). Click the value to open the Tips section of the Efficiency dashboard. Ignores the dashboard time range and the variables.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count() AS tips
FROM cc.tips

panels.description: The most frequent tip category (view cc.tips, last 7 days) with its count in brackets (ties: alphabetical order). Click the value to open the Tips section of the Efficiency dashboard. Ignores the dashboard time range and the variables.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT if(tips = 0, 'none', concat(multiIf(top = 'cache', 'Cache rebuilds', top = 'repeated-read', 'Repeated reads', top = 'big-results', 'Big tool results', top = 'short-opus', 'Short Opus answers', top = 'agent-outlier', 'Costly agent run', top = 'denials', 'Denied tool calls', top = 'slow-hook', 'Slow hooks', top = 'slow-ttft', 'Slow first token', top), ' (', toString(n), ')')) AS most_frequent
FROM
(
    SELECT sum(c) AS tips,
           argMin(category, (-toInt64(c), category)) AS top,
           max(c) AS n
    FROM (SELECT category, count() AS c FROM cc.tips GROUP BY category)
)

panels.title: One row per user prompt with every API request it caused. Click a prompt to open its session.
panels.description: Every panel follows the time range (by the time of the prompt) and the Account, Project, Session, Actor and Skill variables; with Actor or Skill set, only prompts that include such a request are counted (their cost is still the whole prompt). The rail on the left ignores them.

panels.title: Prompts
panels.description: Prompts in the time range: user messages that caused at least one API request. The line above the number: the API requests they caused.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count() AS prompts, concat(toString(sum(p.requests)), ' API requests') AS name
FROM cc.prompts AS p WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR p.account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR p.project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR p.session_id = '${session}') AND p.requests > 0 AND p.started >= $__fromTime AND p.started <= $__toTime AND (('${actor}' = '__all' AND '${skill}' = '__all') OR (p.session_id, p.prompt_id) IN (SELECT session_id, prompt_id FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('${actor}' != '__all' OR '${skill}' != '__all') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}')))

panels.title: Median cost_usd
panels.description: Median cost_usd of a prompt: the sum of api_request cost_usd of all requests it caused (subagents included). On a subscription cost_usd is not a bill.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT quantileExact(0.5)(p.cost_usd) AS cost_usd, 'per prompt' AS name
FROM cc.prompts AS p WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR p.account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR p.project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR p.session_id = '${session}') AND p.requests > 0 AND p.started >= $__fromTime AND p.started <= $__toTime AND (('${actor}' = '__all' AND '${skill}' = '__all') OR (p.session_id, p.prompt_id) IN (SELECT session_id, prompt_id FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('${actor}' != '__all' OR '${skill}' != '__all') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}')))

panels.title: p95 cost_usd
panels.description: 95th percentile of the cost_usd of a prompt: 5 % of the prompts cost more.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT quantileExact(0.95)(p.cost_usd) AS cost_usd, 'top 5% of prompts' AS name
FROM cc.prompts AS p WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR p.account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR p.project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR p.session_id = '${session}') AND p.requests > 0 AND p.started >= $__fromTime AND p.started <= $__toTime AND (('${actor}' = '__all' AND '${skill}' = '__all') OR (p.session_id, p.prompt_id) IN (SELECT session_id, prompt_id FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('${actor}' != '__all' OR '${skill}' != '__all') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}')))

panels.title: Requests per prompt
panels.description: Mean number of API requests per prompt (main, subagent and auxiliary requests). The line above the number: the median.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT avg(p.requests) AS requests, concat('median ', toString(toUInt64(round(quantileExact(0.5)(p.requests))))) AS name
FROM cc.prompts AS p WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR p.account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR p.project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR p.session_id = '${session}') AND p.requests > 0 AND p.started >= $__fromTime AND p.started <= $__toTime AND (('${actor}' = '__all' AND '${skill}' = '__all') OR (p.session_id, p.prompt_id) IN (SELECT session_id, prompt_id FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('${actor}' != '__all' OR '${skill}' != '__all') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}')))

panels.title: Most expensive prompts · click a prompt to open its session
panels.description: The 8 prompts with the highest cost_usd in the time range. A prompt = a user message and every API request until the next one. Model = the model family with the highest cost within the prompt. Requests = all its API requests (main, subagent, auxiliary); Tokens = input + output + cache create; Tools = its tool calls. Click a prompt to open its session on Sessions (the time range zooms to the session; Back or the time picker returns); click a project to filter this dashboard by it. Prompt text is logged only when the client sets OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS=1.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT p.started AS started, p.project AS project,
       if(p.prompt IN ('', '<REDACTED>'), '(text not logged)', leftUTF8(replaceAll(p.prompt, '\n', ' '), 200)) AS prompt,
       m.model AS model, p.requests AS requests,
       p.input + p.output + p.cache_creation AS tokens, round(p.cost_usd, 3) AS cost_usd, p.tool_calls AS tools, p.session_id AS session_id,
       if(w.t1 = 0, toUnixTimestamp64Milli(p.started), w.t0) - greatest(intDiv(3 * (if(w.t1 = 0, toUnixTimestamp64Milli(p.last_event), w.t1) - if(w.t1 = 0, toUnixTimestamp64Milli(p.started), w.t0)), 100), 5000) AS from_ms, if(w.t1 = 0, toUnixTimestamp64Milli(p.last_event), w.t1) + greatest(intDiv(3 * (if(w.t1 = 0, toUnixTimestamp64Milli(p.last_event), w.t1) - if(w.t1 = 0, toUnixTimestamp64Milli(p.started), w.t0)), 100), 5000) AS to_ms
FROM
(
  SELECT * FROM cc.prompts AS p
  WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR p.account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR p.project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR p.session_id = '${session}') AND p.requests > 0 AND p.started >= $__fromTime AND p.started <= $__toTime AND (('${actor}' = '__all' AND '${skill}' = '__all') OR (p.session_id, p.prompt_id) IN (SELECT session_id, prompt_id FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('${actor}' != '__all' OR '${skill}' != '__all') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}')))
  ORDER BY p.cost_usd DESC LIMIT 8
) AS p
LEFT JOIN
(
  SELECT session_id, prompt_id, argMax(fam, c) AS model
  FROM
  (
    SELECT session_id, prompt_id, multiIf(positionCaseInsensitive(model, 'opus') > 0, 'Opus', positionCaseInsensitive(model, 'sonnet') > 0, 'Sonnet', positionCaseInsensitive(model, 'haiku') > 0, 'Haiku', model) AS fam, sum(cost_usd) AS c
    FROM cc.api_requests
    WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
    GROUP BY session_id, prompt_id, fam
  )
  GROUP BY session_id, prompt_id
) AS m ON m.session_id = p.session_id AND m.prompt_id = p.prompt_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT session_id, min(a_s) AS t0, max(a_e) AS t1
  FROM
  (
    SELECT session_id, toUnixTimestamp64Milli(ts) - if(event = 'user_prompt', toInt64(0), toInt64(duration_ms)) AS a_s, toUnixTimestamp64Milli(ts) AS a_e
    FROM cc.events_raw
    WHERE event IN ('user_prompt', 'api_request', 'tool_result')
      AND session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM cc.events_raw WHERE event = 'user_prompt' AND ts >= $__fromTime AND ts <= $__toTime)
  )
  GROUP BY session_id
) AS w ON w.session_id = p.session_id
ORDER BY p.cost_usd DESC

panels.title: Prompts by cost_usd
panels.description: Number of prompts per cost_usd bucket (cost of the whole prompt, time range and all variables apply). Buckets: < $0.05, $0.05–0.2, $0.2–0.5, $0.5–1, $1–3, > $3.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t.1 AS bucket, t.2 AS prompts
FROM
(
  SELECT arrayJoin(arrayZip(['< $0.05', '$0.05–0.2', '$0.2–0.5', '$0.5–1', '$1–3', '> $3'],
           [countIf(c < 0.05), countIf(c >= 0.05 AND c < 0.2), countIf(c >= 0.2 AND c < 0.5), countIf(c >= 0.5 AND c < 1), countIf(c >= 1 AND c < 3), countIf(c >= 3)])) AS t
  FROM (SELECT p.cost_usd AS c FROM cc.prompts AS p WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR p.account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR p.project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR p.session_id = '${session}') AND p.requests > 0 AND p.started >= $__fromTime AND p.started <= $__toTime AND (('${actor}' = '__all' AND '${skill}' = '__all') OR (p.session_id, p.prompt_id) IN (SELECT session_id, prompt_id FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('${actor}' != '__all' OR '${skill}' != '__all') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}'))))
)

panels.title: Mean cost_usd per prompt by model
panels.description: Mean cost_usd of a prompt, per model family; a prompt counts for the family with the highest cost within it. The name shows how many prompts the mean is over. Time range and all variables apply.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT concat(fam, ' · ', toString(n), if(n = 1, ' prompt', ' prompts')) AS name, mean AS value, max(mean) OVER () AS max, 'prefix:$' AS unit,
       multiIf(fam = 'Opus', '#B877D9', fam = 'Sonnet', '#5794F2', fam = 'Haiku', '#73BF69', '#8e8e9e') AS color
FROM
(
  SELECT fam, count() AS n, avg(c) AS mean
  FROM
  (
    SELECT session_id, prompt_id, sum(fc) AS c, argMax(fam, fc) AS fam
    FROM
    (
      SELECT session_id, prompt_id, multiIf(positionCaseInsensitive(model, 'opus') > 0, 'Opus', positionCaseInsensitive(model, 'sonnet') > 0, 'Sonnet', positionCaseInsensitive(model, 'haiku') > 0, 'Haiku', model) AS fam, sum(cost_usd) AS fc
      FROM cc.api_requests
      WHERE prompt_id != '' AND ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND (('${actor}' = '__all' AND '${skill}' = '__all') OR (session_id, prompt_id) IN (SELECT session_id, prompt_id FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('${actor}' != '__all' OR '${skill}' != '__all') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}')))
      GROUP BY session_id, prompt_id, fam
    )
    GROUP BY session_id, prompt_id
  )
  GROUP BY fam
)
ORDER BY mean DESC
